parsed.summary: Tracing the power rails, feedback network, I2C/GPIO/UART links, decoupling, pull-ups, enables and every IC identity/value against the spec shows a self-consistent build; the only textual contradiction (PCA9685 marked 0x41 on the schematic vs 0x40 in the spec table) is required by the drawing itself because INA219 occupies 0x40 on the same I2C2 bus, so the spec's 0x40 entry is a transcription error rather than a deviation in the design files. The barometer RESET/EOC swap and the MAX-8Q/MAX-7Q label-vs-footprint note are explicitly documented properties, not anomalies.
